input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year. If Client decides to discontinue its Hosting Service, Client is responsible for arranging for a new name server within 30 days.
input.rationale: Section 13 (p0078) provides automatic successive one-year renewals that either party may stop by written notice of intent not to renew given 30 days before the end of the year: a 30-day window, comfortably inside the 60-day fallback ceiling, so no edit is needed there. The gap is renewal pricing. Section 6 (p0047) freezes Hosting Services costs only "for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement", leaving every renewal term repriceable without limit, which fails the fallback requirement that increases be capped at 5%. The single inserted sentence supplies that cap and nothing else. Retained mechanics survive intact: the Section 6 first-year freeze and most-favoured-rate covenant, the Section 12 termination cross-reference and the 30/60-day discontinuation timelines, and the cap is confined to "any renewal term" so it cannot collide with the first-year freeze. The cap reads on TrueLink's fees generally rather than only Hosting Services fees, which operates in Client's favour. Preferred wording is not pressed: there is no Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal and the cap is a flat 5% rather than the lesser of CPI and 3%.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.

mappings.element: If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6 freezes pricing only for the first year, so renewals could reprice without limit; we have added our fallback 5% cap on fee increases in any renewal term. The existing 30-day non-renewal notice in Section 13 is acceptable and is left unchanged.

ops.text: TrueLink's fees will not increase by more than five percent (5%) in any renewal term.
